children: Guardant Health received CE-marking for Guardant360 CDx in Europe as a companion diagnostic to identify ER+, HER2- advanced breast cancer patients for AstraZeneca’s camizestrant, following prior approvals in the U.S. and Japan.
Expands addressable market for the test across Europe, supporting adoption and potential test volume growth.
Links test usage to a new therapy rollout, creating pull-through demand tied to drug adoption.
Non-invasive testing can drive earlier, repeat testing, supporting recurring revenue.
Reinforces clinical utility and multi-region alignment, aiding standardized uptake.
Signals broad pharma partnerships and a mature CDx portfolio, reducing platform risk.

This is a mid-cycle expansion of a known trend: Guardant extending liquid biopsy CDx across major markets. A larger catalyst would be evidence of EU uptake—reimbursement wins, test volume disclosures, or partnerships driving measurable revenue impact.
